# Kestrel Field Operations Notes (FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT)

This is invented sample content for a software demo. Kestrel Field, the Marrow Basin and
Tallgrass Fictional Energy do not exist.

## Artificial lift

Kestrel-4 had an electric submersible pump (ESP) failure on 2026-02-11. The pump was pulled and
replaced during a six day workover. Kestrel-2 and Kestrel-3 run on rod pumps and have had no
failures this year.

## Safety and environment

There were zero lost-time incidents in the first quarter of 2026. Gas is gathered to a compressor
at the central tank battery. Flaring is limited to upset conditions and totalled 4.2 MMscf in March.

## Workover schedule

The next planned workover is a tubing replacement on Kestrel-2 in the third quarter of 2026.
Crew availability is the main constraint, so the date may move.
